title: 2 safe after Cessna makes emergency landing in Pampanga

blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — An instructor and a student pilot escaped unharmed after their light aircraft made an emergency landing in a rice field in Arayat, Pampanga, on Saturday afternoon, Oct. 3. Lt. Sherlyn Bañares, duty officer of the Philippine National Police Aviation Security Unit 3, told the Inquirer by phone that the incident occurred around 2:30 p.m. Bañares said the US-made, two-seater Cessna 152, bearing body number RP-C8864, made the emergency landing in a rice field along the Magalang-Arayat Road in Barangay San Antonio after its 41-year-old pilot noticed unusual vibrations. “The training aircraft left Omni Aviation School in Clark […]...
